title: "Route Punctuality Report"
code-fold: true

---

```{r}
punctuality <- data.frame(
  route = c("Harbour–Airport", "West Loop", "University Line"),
  peak = c(71, 88, 90),
  off_peak = c(85, 94, 96)
)
punctuality$gap <- punctuality$off_peak - punctuality$peak
punctuality
```
